current_activity: provisional panzer group assumes command in the Argentan sector; XLVII Panzer Corps headquarters arrives there
notes: Event date: on 12 August Panzer Group Eberbach assumed command in the Argentan sector and the XLVII Panzer Corps headquarters, having handed its Mortain responsibility to the LVIII Panzer Corps, arrived at Argentan (Breakout and Pursuit ch. 25 p. 502); the group's headquarters had been formed for the second Avranches attack, directly under Army Group B (p. 483). Location approximate: the source names the Argentan sector, not a headquarters site; the point is Argentan (10 km). The date of formation is not given; 12 August is the first documented date. Opponents: the XV Corps (US) and the French 2nd Armored Division attacked toward Argentan (ch. 25 p. 502).
